chunks: Muyassir narrated from Hafs, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

I said to him: A man intends fulfillment, but when he measures, he does not do the measuring well. He said: What do those around him say? He said: I said: They say he does not give full measure. He said: He is among those for whom it is not appropriate to measure.

key_terms.الْوَفَاءُ: fulfilling properly and giving what is due
key_terms.كَالَ: he measured out goods by volume
key_terms.لَا يَنْبَغِي: it is not appropriate or suitable
key_terms.لَا يُوفِي: he does not give in full

ai.seo_question: Is a good intention enough if someone cannot measure properly in trade?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that good intention alone is not sufficient in commercial dealings if a person repeatedly fails to give full measure. If people around him recognize that he does not fulfill proper measurement, then he should not be entrusted with that task. The narration emphasizes honesty, competence, and protection of the rights of others in trade.
